description: The agent-level button says 'Revoke access' and sits beside '2 ACTIVE KEYS'; nothing on the button says it kills every key and that CI would stop. The confirm text says 'all API keys' but does not list which keys (names, count) or say it cannot be undone. A user in a hurry (stolen laptop) can pick the bigger hammer by mistake.
expected: Button text such as 'Revoke all keys'; confirm text that names the keys ('ci runner, hana laptop') and says new keys will be needed.
actual: step-1-agent-row.png; confirm text 'Revoke all API keys for walker-c-ci? This stops this agent’s current access.'
suggested_fix: Rename to 'Revoke all keys', list keys in an in-app confirm dialog.

criterion: One way per task / duplicated info
description: Agent, key count and revoke exist on both Agents and API keys tabs with different scopes of effect, so the user has to know which tab is the surgical one. The Agents tab could show the agent's keys (expand row) with per-key Revoke, which would make the 2-step story a 1-step story.
expected: Expandable keys under the agent row, each with Revoke.
suggested_fix: Show the key list inside the agent row, or link '2 ACTIVE KEYS' to the API keys tab filtered to that agent.

description: The key list has no per-agent filter, so finding the two ci-bot keys means scrolling a list that includes revoked keys from other agents; revoked and active rows are mixed. Key rows also differ in their meta line ('hana laptop' lacks 'issued by research-bot' while 'ci runner' has it) which makes sibling keys of one agent look different.
expected: Filter or group by agent; consistent meta line.

description: As in STORY-062 and STORY-065 the revoke notice is not visible after revoking near the bottom of the list, and the API keys tab opens at the previous tab's scroll offset.
expected: Visible confirmation; tab opens at top.
actual: step-4-revoked.png shows only the badge change.
